name: Yakuin Wako
source:
She is a first year high school student who is in the Love Support Committee. She is a dry, gloomy kouhai. She is expected to be the student council president and she joins the Love Support Committee on the way. Her hair is bleached and dyed. She seems to be worried about Yanagawa...?

[Translated from [url=https://sonokoi-horyu.net/character/]official website[/url]]
